pattern_explanation: These words look or sound alike in both languages because they came from the same European roots, but their meanings drifted apart over time, so the look-alike form is misleading.
false_friend_warning: Careful: the Turkish word 'pasta' looks like English 'pasta', but it means cake, while English 'pasta' means noodles. Also, 'sempatik' does not mean sympathetic; it means friendly.
